nindian-economy-23-3.s: NITI Aayog, which replaced the Planning Commission, was established through:
nindian-economy-23-3.x: NITI Aayog was set up by a Union Cabinet resolution to replace the Planning Commission; it is not created by any Act or amendment.

nindian-economy-24-2.s: In the Governing Council of NITI Aayog, Union Territories with legislatures such as Delhi and Puducherry are represented by their:
nindian-economy-24-2.x: UTs with legislatures, such as Delhi and Puducherry, are represented by their Chief Ministers; only the other UTs send Lieutenant Governors.

ne3440d06fb1.s: The Deputy Chairman and Member-Secretary of the Planning Commission correspond in NITI Aayog to the:
ne3440d06fb1.x: The Planning Commission had a Deputy Chairman and Member-Secretary; NITI Aayog has a Vice-Chairperson and a CEO.

nf624049a697.s: Who succeeded Arvind Panagariya as Vice-Chairperson of NITI Aayog in 2017?
nf624049a697.x: Rajiv Kumar (2017) followed Arvind Panagariya (2015); Suman K. Bery came in May 2022 and Ashok Kumar Lahiri in April 2026.

nf903d4995bd.s: The Sustainable Development Report, which carries the global SDG Index, is published by:
nf903d4995bd.x: The Sustainable Development Report / SDG Index is an SDSN publication; NITI Aayog publishes the national SDG India Index.

n4888cc576d7.s: By giving measurable comparisons of development performance across States, NITI Aayog's indices mainly strengthen:
n4888cc576d7.x: Measurable State comparisons that link national goals to district outcomes strengthen competitive federalism.

n54ccfc0d36c.s: How many indicators aligned with MoSPI's National Indicator Framework did the SDG India Index 2023-24 use?
n54ccfc0d36c.x: The 2023-24 edition used 113 indicators aligned with MoSPI's National Indicator Framework.

nbb00e41f912.s: Compared with economic growth, the scope of economic development is:
o: Narrower, as it is a part of growth
Limited to a rise in output
nbb00e41f912.x: Economic development is broader than growth and includes it, with qualitative as well as quantitative dimensions.

n56bc1692828.s: Progress under Andhra Pradesh's Swarna Andhra @2047 targets is tracked through how many KPIs?
n56bc1692828.x: Swarna Andhra @2047 targets GSDP of Rs 308 lakh crore, per capita income of Rs 55 lakh and 15%+ growth, tracked through 651 KPIs.

nindian-economy-27-3.s: A rise in real GNP does not mean higher economic development if ____ increase.
nindian-economy-27-3.x: Higher real GNP need not mean development, because poverty and unemployment can still rise.

n63952a1ca8c.s: In Rostow's stages of economic growth, which stage immediately follows 'take-off'?
n63952a1ca8c.x: Rostow's sequence is traditional society, pre-conditions for take-off, take-off, drive to maturity and age of high mass consumption.

nindian-economy-5-3.s: Which index measures development through life expectancy, education and income, which GDP alone does not capture?
nindian-economy-5-3.x: The HDI combines life expectancy, education and income, so it captures development beyond GDP.

nindian-economy-35-6.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Economic growth – quantitative rise in actual output
Economic development – narrower in scope than growth
Economic growth – qualitative improvement in capabilities
Economic development – measured by GDP growth alone
nindian-economy-35-6.x: Economic growth is a quantitative rise in actual output, measured by GDP and GNP growth; development is broader and cannot be measured by GDP alone.

n38e30517d1a.s: In a Lorenz curve, greater distance from the 45-degree line indicates:
n38e30517d1a.x: The farther the Lorenz curve lies from the 45-degree line of equality, the greater the income inequality.

n5b3bd03a94a.s: Which of the following is a component of the HDI but not of the Physical Quality of Life Index?
n5b3bd03a94a.x: PQLI uses literacy, infant mortality and life expectancy at age one; GNI per capita at PPP belongs to the HDI.

n9f6f40ffcaa.s: In the UNDP Human Development Report 1996, growth in which output rises but jobs do not is called:
n9f6f40ffcaa.x: Jobless growth means output rises without jobs; it was one of five bad growths (jobless, ruthless, voiceless, rootless, futureless) in HDR 1996.

new.s: Which of the following is a statutory body?
new.x: Zonal Councils are statutory, set up under the States Reorganisation Act, 1956. NITI Aayog and the Planning Commission are non-statutory; the Finance Commission is constitutional.

new.s: What is the maximum number of part-time members of NITI Aayog?
new.x: NITI Aayog can have at most 2 part-time members, from universities and research bodies, on a rotational basis.

new.s: At most how many Union Ministers can the Prime Minister nominate as ex-officio members of NITI Aayog?
new.x: Up to 4 Union Ministers nominated by the PM are ex-officio members.

new.s: The number of full-time members of NITI Aayog is:
new.x: The number of full-time members is not fixed; there are 5 at present (3 in 2015). Up to 8 full-time members was the Planning Commission's limit.

new.s: The Vice-Chairperson of NITI Aayog is appointed by the:
new.x: The Vice-Chairperson is appointed by the Prime Minister and holds Cabinet Minister rank.

new.s: The Vice-Chairperson of NITI Aayog holds the rank of a:
o: Secretary to the Government of India
new.x: The Vice-Chairperson has Cabinet Minister rank; the CEO holds the rank of Secretary to the Government of India.

new.s: Special invitees of NITI Aayog are:
o: Chief Ministers nominated by the President
Domain experts and practitioners nominated by the PM
new.x: Special invitees are domain experts and practitioners nominated by the Prime Minister.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about NITI Aayog's office-holders?
o: The Vice-Chairperson and the CEO are separate posts
The Vice-Chairperson also serves as the CEO
The CEO holds the rank of Secretary to the Government of India
The Vice-Chairperson is appointed by the Prime Minister
new.x: The VC and CEO are separate posts; there is no Vice-Chairman-cum-CEO.

new.s: Who became Vice-Chairperson of NITI Aayog on 25 April 2026?
new.x: Ashok Kumar Lahiri, a former Chief Economic Adviser, took over from Suman K. Bery on 25 April 2026.

new.s: Who was appointed CEO of NITI Aayog in July 2026 for two years?
new.x: Anurag Jain, a 1989-batch IAS officer and former Madhya Pradesh Chief Secretary, became CEO in July 2026.

new.s: Amitabh Kant took charge as CEO of NITI Aayog on:
new.x: Amitabh Kant was CEO from 17 February 2016 to 2022; B.V.R. Subrahmanyam took over on 25 February 2023.

new.s: Under NITI Aayog's Cabinet resolution, credible plans are to be formulated at which level and aggregated progressively upwards?
new.x: The resolution calls for credible plans at village level, aggregated progressively to higher levels.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about NITI Aayog's guiding approach:
1. It follows a bottom-up approach.
2. It embraces Antyodaya.
3. It gives sole preference to large enterprises.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: NITI's approach is bottom-up, cooperative federalism and Antyodaya, with a focus on small enterprises; it does not prefer only large enterprises.

new.s:
Assertion (A): NITI Aayog is a non-constitutional advisory body.
Reason (R): NITI Aayog's resolution calls for credible plans at village level aggregated progressively upwards.
o: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
new.x: Both are true, but village-level planning does not explain why NITI is a non-constitutional advisory body.

new.s: The Regional Councils of NITI Aayog are headed jointly by:
o: A rotational Chief Minister of the group and a Central Minister
The Prime Minister and the Vice-Chairperson
The Union Home Minister and the Governors
The CEO and the Chief Secretaries
new.x: Regional Councils deal with issues affecting more than one State and are headed jointly by a rotational CM and a Central Minister.

new.s: How many Chief Ministers attended the 11th Governing Council meeting of NITI Aayog, the first with 100% attendance?
new.x: The 11th meeting on 11 June 2026 was the first attended by all 28 Chief Ministers.

new.s: The Governing Council of NITI Aayog was first constituted in:
new.x: It was first constituted in February 2015 and reconstituted in February 2021.

new.s: Which two hubs function within NITI Aayog?
o: Team India Hub and Fund Allocation Hub
Team India Hub and Knowledge and Innovation Hub
State Finance Hub and Knowledge and Innovation Hub
new.x: NITI's two hubs are the Team India Hub (Centre-State partnership) and the Knowledge and Innovation Hub.

new.s: AIM 2.0, approved in 2024 with an outlay of Rs 2,750 crore, runs up to:
new.x: AIM 2.0 (2024) has Rs 2,750 crore up to March 2028.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: SETU Steering Committee – chaired by the Vice-Chairperson
Atal Innovation Mission – set up in 2018
DMEO – merger of PEO and IEO
new.x: DMEO (2015) merged the PEO and IEO. NILERD was formerly IAMR, the SETU committee is chaired by the CEO and AIM began in 2016.

new.s: NITI Aayog's 7-year Strategy covered the period:
new.x: The 7-year Strategy ran from 2017-18 to 2023-24; the Three Year Action Agenda covered 2017-18 to 2019-20.

new.s: NITI Aayog's 'Strategy for New India @75', released on 19 December 2018, was launched by:
new.x: Strategy for New India @75 was launched by Arun Jaitley on 19 December 2018.

new.s: NITI Aayog's 15-year Vision document runs up to:
new.x: The 15-year Vision runs up to 2030, alongside the 7-year Strategy and 3-year Action Agenda mandated in 2016.

new.s: How many areas does the 'Strategy for New India @75' cover?
new.x: Strategy for New India @75 covers 41 areas with targets for 2022-23.

new.s: The Planning Commission, unlike NITI Aayog, followed which approach to planning?
new.x: The Planning Commission's plans were top-down and one-size-fits-all; NITI is bottom-up with a Vision-Strategy-Action Agenda.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Planning Commission:
1. It had no part-time members.
2. Its plans went to the National Development Council for approval.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: the Planning Commission had up to 8 full-time members and no part-time members, and its plans went to the NDC for approval.

new.s: In 2023, NITI Aayog agreed to set up which body for Andhra Pradesh under the State Support Mission?
new.x: In 2023 NITI agreed to set up a State Institution for Transformation for AP under the State Support Mission.

new.s: Under NITI Aayog's G-HUB initiative, Visakhapatnam is one of how many pilot cities?
new.x: Visakhapatnam is one of four pilot cities under the City and Regional Growth Hubs (G-HUB) initiative.

new.s: How many indicators does MoSPI's National Indicator Framework for SDGs have (2026)?
new.x: The NIF has 277 indicators; 113 is the SDG India Index 2023-24 count and 169 the number of SDG targets.

new.s: The School Education Quality Index (SEQI) is published by:
new.x: SEQI is a NITI Aayog index; Kerala topped it in 2019.

new.s: The Composite Water Management Index is published by:
new.x: The Composite Water Management Index is published by NITI Aayog; Yale and Columbia publish the Environmental Performance Index.

new.s: The NER District SDG Index (first edition August 2021) was prepared by NITI Aayog with:
o: MoDoNER, with technical support from UNDP
MoSPI, with technical support from UNICEF
SDSN, with technical support from WRI India
UN Statistics Division, with support from MoSPI
new.x: The NER District SDG Index is by NITI Aayog and MoDoNER, with UNDP technical support.

new.s: The SDG-NIF Progress Report is published by:
new.x: The SDG-NIF Progress Report is a MoSPI publication; the Global SDG Report is by the UN Statistics Division.

new.s: In the SDG India Index, a State is classed as an 'Achiever' when its score is:
new.x: Achiever = 100; Front Runner = 65-99; Performer = 50-64; Aspirant = below 50.

new.s: A State scoring between 50 and 64 in the SDG India Index is classed as:
new.x: Scores of 50-64 make a Performer; below 50 is Aspirant.

new.s: Which State was at the bottom of the SDG India Index 2023-24?
new.x: Bihar (57) was at the bottom, followed by Jharkhand (62).

new.s: In the SDG India Index 2023-24, Andhra Pradesh's rank in SDG 14 (Life Below Water) was:
new.x: AP was 2nd in SDG 14 in both 2020-21 and 2023-24, and 1st in SDG 7.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's overall rank in the SDG India Index fell to 9th in 2023-24 from which rank in 2020-21?
new.x: AP was 4th in 2020-21 (score 72) and 9th in 2023-24 (score 74): its score rose but its rank fell.

new.s: Which State topped the School Education Quality Index (2019)?
new.x: Kerala topped SEQI 2019; Gujarat topped the Composite Water Management Index.

new.s: Which State topped NITI Aayog's Composite Water Management Index (2019)?
new.x: Gujarat topped the CWMI 2019.

new.s: In the Export Preparedness Index 2022, topped by Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh ranked:
new.x: Tamil Nadu topped the Export Preparedness Index 2022 and AP was 8th.

new.s: Which State ranked last in NITI Aayog's Fiscal Health Index 2026?
new.x: Punjab was last in FHI 2026; Odisha topped it, Goa and Jharkhand were Achievers and AP was 17th.

new.s: In the India Innovation Index 2021, which State led the North-East and hill States category?
new.x: Manipur led the NE and hill States; Karnataka led the major States and Chandigarh the UTs and city States.

new.s: The Atal Innovation Mission, set up in 2016, functions under:
new.x: AIM's parent body is NITI Aayog, not the Ministry of Education.

new.s: The Atal Innovation Mission was formed on:
new.x: AIM was formed on 16 January 2016 under NITI Aayog.

new.s: Atal Tinkering Labs under the Atal Innovation Mission are set up in:
new.x: ATLs are in schools for grades 6-12, with tools such as 3D printing, robotics and IoT; Atal Incubation Centres serve start-ups.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (AIM component – purpose) is correctly matched?
o: Atal Tinkering Labs – innovation in underserved areas
Atal Incubation Centres – business incubators for start-ups
Mentor India Campaign – product innovation for national needs
Atal New India Challenges – mentors for ATLs and AICs
new.x: Atal Incubation Centres are business incubators for start-ups. Community Innovation Centres serve underserved areas, New India Challenges seek product innovation and Mentor India provides mentors.

new.s: The Aspirational Districts Programme, launched in January 2018, covers how many districts?
new.x: ADP covers 112 backward districts; 500 is the number of blocks under the Aspirational Blocks Programme.

new.s: Which two themes carry 30% weight each in the Aspirational Districts Programme?
o: Agriculture and Water Resources; Basic Infrastructure
Health and Nutrition; Agriculture and Water Resources
new.x: Health and Nutrition and Education carry 30% each; Agriculture and Water Resources 20%; Financial Inclusion and Basic Infrastructure 10% each.

new.s: Aspirational districts are ranked monthly on the Champions of Change dashboard by:
o: Score bands of the SDG India Index
new.x: Districts are ranked by delta ranking, which measures incremental progress.

new.s: The core strategy of the Aspirational Districts Programme is:
new.x: ADP rests on Convergence, Collaboration and Competition.

new.s: Which Andhra Pradesh district topped the baseline ranking of the Aspirational Districts Programme?
new.x: Vizianagaram topped the baseline ranking (48.13%).

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh in the Aspirational Districts Programme:
1. Vizianagaram, Visakhapatnam and YSR Kadapa were the original three districts.
2. After the 2022 reorganisation, Parvathipuram Manyam replaced Vizianagaram.
3. YSR Kadapa was dropped after the 2022 reorganisation.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. YSR Kadapa continues in the programme; Alluri Sitharama Raju replaced Visakhapatnam.

new.s: The Aspirational Blocks Programme was launched on:
new.x: ABP was launched on 7 January 2023 at the 2nd National Conference of Chief Secretaries.

new.s: The Aspirational Blocks Programme monitors its 500 blocks on how many key performance indicators?
new.x: ABP tracks 40 KPIs quarterly; ADP uses 49 indicators.

new.s: NITI Aayog's 'Strategy for New India @75' was released in:
new.x: Strategy for New India @75 was released in 2018; the Vision-Strategy-Action Agenda framework dates from 2016.

new.s: Swarna Andhra @2047, aligned with Viksit Bharat @2047, was written under which NITI Aayog initiative?
new.x: State Vision @2047 documents such as Swarna Andhra @2047 are written by States under the State Support Mission.

new.s: India's national multidimensional poverty headcount in 2019-21 was:
new.x: National MPI fell from 55.3% (2005-06) to 14.96% (2019-21), with an estimated 11.28% in 2022-23.

new.s: How many people in India left multidimensional poverty during 2015-21?
new.x: 135 million people left multidimensional poverty between 2015 and 2021.

new.s: In the Sustainable Development Report 2025, India ranked 99th out of how many countries?
new.x: India was 99th of 167 in SDR 2025, entering the top 100 for the first time; 166 was the SDR 2023 total.

new.s: The theory of unbalanced growth is associated with:
new.x: Hirschman propounded unbalanced growth; Nurkse is linked with balanced growth and the vicious circle of poverty.

new.s: The theory of balanced growth is associated mainly with:
new.x: Balanced growth is linked with Nurkse (with Rosenstein-Rodan); Hirschman argued for unbalanced growth.

new.s: The growth model linking the growth rate to the saving rate and the capital-output ratio is the:
new.x: The Harrod-Domar model relates growth to the saving rate divided by the capital-output ratio.

new.s: 'Economic Theory and Underdeveloped Regions' (1957) was written by:
new.x: Gunnar Myrdal wrote Economic Theory and Underdeveloped Regions (1957).

new.s: 'The Strategy of Economic Development' (1958) was written by:
new.x: A.O. Hirschman wrote The Strategy of Economic Development (1958).

new.s: 'Strategic Factors in Economic Development' was written by:
new.x: Charles P. Kindleberger wrote Strategic Factors in Economic Development.

new.s: The basic needs approach to development is associated with:
new.x: The basic needs approach came from the ILO (1976) and Paul Streeten.

new.s: The welfare approach to development is associated with:
new.x: The welfare approach is linked with Pigou; Sen is linked with the capability approach.

new.s: Mahbub ul Haq built the Human Development Index on the ideas of:
new.x: Mahbub ul Haq built the HDI on Amartya Sen's ideas.

new.s: The Measure of Economic Welfare (MEW) and Net Economic Welfare (NEW) are associated respectively with:
o: Morris D. Morris and Mahbub ul Haq
new.x: MEW is by Nordhaus and Tobin (1972); NEW is by Paul Samuelson.

new.s: Simon Kuznets developed per capita real income as a measure of development in:
new.x: Kuznets developed the per capita income method in the US in 1934; he received the Nobel in 1971.

new.s: In the Human Development Index, life expectancy is measured at:
new.x: HDI uses life expectancy at birth; PQLI uses life expectancy at age one.

new.s: The Multidimensional Poverty Index was developed in 2010 by:
new.x: MPI was developed by OPHI and UNDP in 2010; the Overseas Development Council is linked with PQLI.

new.s: Gross National Happiness was introduced in Bhutan in the 1970s by:
new.x: Bhutan's fourth King, Jigme Singye Wangchuck, introduced GNH as an alternative to GDP.

new.s: The Wholesale Price Index in India is compiled by the:
new.x: WPI is compiled by the Office of the Economic Adviser; CPI and IIP are compiled by the NSO.

new.s: The environmental Kuznets curve shows that, as per capita income rises, pollution:
new.x: The environmental Kuznets curve applies Kuznets' inverted-U idea: pollution rises and then falls with per capita income.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Lorenz curve – gives a numerical measure of inequality
Phillips curve – inverse relation between inflation and unemployment
Laffer curve – beyond a point higher tax rates cut revenue
Kuznets curve – inverted-U relation of inequality
new.x: The Lorenz curve is visual only; the Gini coefficient gives the number. The other pairs are correct.

new.s: The Gini coefficient was introduced by Corrado Gini in:
new.x: Gini's coefficient dates from 1912; the Lorenz curve from 1905.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about indicators of economic development:
1. Institutional change is a valid indicator.
2. A larger GDP share from the primary sector indicates development.
3. Structural transformation from agriculture to industry and services is an indicator.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. A larger GDP share from the primary sector is not an indicator of development.

new.s: Which of the following is a barrier to economic growth rather than a contributor?
new.x: Corruption is a governance barrier; capital formation, technical progress and human capital are economic determinants of growth.

new.s: According to the Planning Commission, the most important factor of economic growth is:
new.x: The Planning Commission treated capital formation as the most important growth factor.

new.s: Green GDP is GDP minus the cost of:
o: Natural resource depletion and environmental degradation
new.x: Green GDP deducts natural resource depletion and environmental degradation costs from GDP.

new.s: The Brundtland Commission report (1987) that defined sustainable development is titled:
new.x: The Brundtland report, Our Common Future (1987), defined sustainable development.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's GSDP for 2025-26 is estimated at:
new.x: AP's GSDP for 2025-26 is Rs 17.62 lakh crore (+10.75%); Rs 308 lakh crore is the Swarna Andhra @2047 target.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's per capita income in 2025-26 was:
new.x: AP's per capita income was Rs 2,94,507 against India's Rs 2,19,575.
